title: The Kidney, Water Balance and Plant Hormones

flashcard_questions.q: The removal of metabolic waste products from the body, including urea, carbon dioxide, and excess water.
A toxic nitrogen-containing waste produced when excess amino acids are broken down in the liver by deamination.
The breakdown of excess amino acids in the liver, removing the amino group to produce ammonia, which is then converted to urea.

flashcard_questions.a: The functional unit of the kidney containing a glomerulus and tubule system that filters blood and produces urine.
A tiny ball of capillaries inside the Bowman’s capsule where blood is filtered under high pressure.
